text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation. The presentation of sudden-onset back pain following exertion, radiating into the leg and foot, is classic for nerve root compression. Given your age and the specific radiation pattern, this is the most likely cause.
